facts.statement: Bigfoot was reported near Camp Chatty during the summer camp event week, and players were invited to seek it out.
facts.quote: Si tu es à la recherche de Bigfoot près du Camp d’été de Chatty

facts.statement: Summer Camp update: players were told to log in to check new quests, activities, loot items, clothing, Marketplace and Camp Store items, and housing decorations.
facts.quote: Connectez-vous aujourd'hui pour vérifier des nouvelles quêtes, des activités, des objets butin, des vêtements

article_summaries.title: Camp d'été – La Semaine d'Aventure! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post from Free Realms' summer camp event run, announcing the 'Adventure Week' theme and listing when in-game events run. It also explains how to use the in-game Game Guide calendar to find events and teleport to them. The post gives no exact date (only 'posted 11 months, 1 week ago' relative to capture).

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This French-language patch note (headed 'Les Notes de Mise à Jour (04/06/2010)') announces a Summer Camp event with Chatty and Robbie camps near the Greenwood Forest warpstone, including new Marketplace and Camp Store items, a playground near the Sanctuary warpstone, a housing surprise-block option, next-generation doctor equipment on the Station Cash marketplace, and multi-month subscriptions. The date is read from dd/mm/yyyy and is not otherwise confirmed.
